Backups to object storage, about $1 a month

WhatsApp, after [two evenings] and one forum thread
AI answers from our help docs
lose: Product tours. If you use them, skip this swap

Certainty past 20 seats. Haven't tested it

keep: Completion rate within [a point] over [3 weeks]
lose: A slightly nicer-looking form. Clients haven't mentioned it

slides.title: What we actually did, in order

steps.text: Rented the smallest Hetzner box, about $6. Took ten minutes.
Installed Docker, started Twenty. The make command does most of it.
Started Chatwoot on the same box. Then spent [two evenings] on WhatsApp.
Imported the HubSpot CSV, added the chat widget, ran both stacks in parallel for [two weeks], then cancelled.

slides.time: About a weekend plus the WhatsApp evenings. Skills needed: copy, paste, patience.

slides.text: If the $6 box dies on a Saturday, that's our Saturday. For $2,263 a month, we'll take the Saturday.

slides.title: One swap a day. Free when it's good enough, cheap when it isn't.
